description:
Discover this boutique off-plan development of just 36 design-led apartments overlooking the Mediterranean in Torreblanca, Costa del Sol. Created for those who value tranquillity, refined living, and panoramic sea views, these homes offer space to reconnect with what matters. Each one-, two- and three-bedroom apartment, along with an exclusive penthouse, is thoughtfully designed with open-plan interiors, large-format flooring, soft tones, and expansive sea-facing terraces that bring the coast to your doorstep. Elegant kitchens come fully equipped with premium appliances, while built-in wardrobes, dressing areas, and air conditioning ensure everyday comfort.

Set within a private gated community, this boutique development offers beautifully landscaped Mediterranean gardens, a resort-style pool and sun deck, and a fully equipped indoor gym. Life here is peaceful yet connected—the beach, Torreblanca train station, and local cafés are just minutes away. Fuengirola, Los Boliches, and the Michelin-starred Sollo restaurant are all within easy reach, with Málaga, Marbella and Puerto Banús only a short drive away.

Whether you’re looking for a stylish new home, a holiday apartment on the Costa del Sol, or a prime property investment, this fabulous apartment development delivers coastal elegance with everyday ease. Private underground parking and lift access to all residences complete the picture.

This is not just a property—it’s a lifestyle of light, space, and Mediterranean calm. Register your interest now to receive availability, floor plans, and early pricing.
